You punch the sentry, aiming for his jaw. Quintus reacts with military precision, deflecting your punch with the shaft of his **pilum**. He then drives the butt end of the pilum hard into your sternum. You stagger back a step, spitting blood. Quintus drops his pilum and draws his gladius in one fluid motion, leveling the point at your chest.
